name: RockAuto
physical_step: ships from many supplier warehouses (reported, unverified)
ai_role: drill-down catalogue by make, year, model, engine; no AI found
traction: revenue not public; grew by word of mouth among DIY mechanics (trade press)
pl_adaptation_angle: English-only site; a Polish version would need TecDoc-type fit data and EU suppliers

name: CarParts.com
physical_step: own distribution centres; ships parcels
ai_role: vehicle selector; no AI found
traction: revenue USD 547.5 m fiscal 2025 (-7%), net loss USD 50.4 m
pl_adaptation_angle: no lesson to copy beyond a warning: a scaled parts e-tailer can shrink and lose money

name: PartsTech
physical_step: none by PartsTech; suppliers deliver to the shop
ai_role: search across supplier catalogues and stock from inside shop software
traction: used by over 15,000 repair shops; nearly 12 m parts; USD 35 m Series C (May 2023)
repeat_signal: daily use by shops (implied by model, unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: Polish workshops order mostly by phone or wholesaler portals (Inter Cars); a multi-wholesaler search would need API access to Inter Cars, Auto Partner, Hart

name: Car-Part.com
physical_step: recyclers hold and ship parts
ai_role: used-part search with interchange across ~4,500 recyclers
traction: about 4,500 recyclers and 190 m parts listed (undated company page)
pl_adaptation_angle: Ovoko already does this in Poland (ovoko.pl); gap would be a niche (vans, classics)

name: RevolutionParts
physical_step: dealers ship OEM parts
ai_role: e-commerce and catalogue software for dealer parts departments; eBay and Walmart feeds
traction: nearly USD 3 bn parts sold to date; 3.2 m orders and over USD 600 m sales in 2022; 1,800+ dealers (May 2023)
pl_adaptation_angle: Polish ASO dealers sell OEM parts mostly at the counter; a dealer web-shop tool would need OEM catalogue licences

name: RepairPal
physical_step: certified shops do the repair
ai_role: Fair Price Estimator from labour guides, OEM part prices and local labour rates
traction: 3,500 certified repair locations (company milestone release); raised USD 7 m to 2013
pl_adaptation_angle: a Polish fair-price estimator would need labour-time data (Audatex/DAT type) and local rates

name: Wrench (incl. YourMechanic)
physical_step: mobile technicians repair at the customer's place; parts delivered to the job
ai_role: quote and scheduling automation; no AI found
traction: after the YourMechanic deal: over 35,000 zip codes, 20,000+ private and fleet vehicles a month (company)
pl_adaptation_angle: mobile mechanic in Polish cities would need technician supply; physical work outside founder limits

name: Tire Rack
physical_step: own warehouses; ships to customer or to installers; mobile installation
ai_role: vehicle tyre selector and test data
traction: acquired by Discount Tire (deal expected to close 31 Dec 2021)
pl_adaptation_angle: Oponeo already plays this role in Poland

name: FIXD
physical_step: none (sensor shipped by post)
ai_role: OBD-II sensor + app translates fault codes into plain words and repair cost
traction: 1.4 m installs (third-party app estimate, unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: code-to-part routing for Polish drivers would need tie-in to parts shops; ChatGPT already explains codes

name: Openbay
physical_step: shops do the work
ai_role: online quotes from shops; SaaS for repair shops
traction: USD 8 m Series A led by Shell Ventures (2018)
pl_adaptation_angle: quote marketplaces exist in Poland (Oferteo, Dobry Mechanik); weak gap

name: RevZilla
physical_step: own warehouse
ai_role: fit guides and video reviews (content); no AI found
traction: more than USD 10 m revenue in 2010; merged with Cycle Gear into Comoto (2016)
pl_adaptation_angle: FC-Moto and Louis ship to Poland; content-led motorcycle shop in Polish is a niche option

name: Versable
physical_step: none
ai_role: LLM with retrieval generates titles, specs and fitment from part numbers
traction: raised USD 2.6-3.1 m (third-party profile, unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: shows AI fitment data for shops is a funded product; Polish Allegro sellers lack fit data

name: Autodoc
physical_step: own central warehouses; ships parcels across Europe
ai_role: catalogue by car model and registration (TecDoc-based, unverified)
traction: revenue EUR 1,807.9 m 2025 (+16.3%), 9.3 m active customers, 18.9 m orders, 27 countries
repeat_signal: 18.9 m orders / 9.3 m active customers = ~2 orders per customer per year (computed, same source)
take_rate_or_margin: gross profit ~42% of revenue (computed in friction-patterns.md from the same report)
pl_adaptation_angle: already in Poland (autodoc.pl); no gap in mainstream parts

name: kfzteile24
physical_step: own warehouse and branches; ships parcels
ai_role: vehicle search by HSN/TSN key numbers (unverified)
traction: revenue EUR 165.6 m in 2016 (latest primary-type figure found)
pl_adaptation_angle: German-only; shows HSN/TSN (registration-document key) search; Polish analogue would use the dowód rejestracyjny fields

name: Delticom (ReifenDirekt)
physical_step: ships tyres; partner fitting stations (count not found)
ai_role: tyre selector by vehicle; no AI found
traction: group revenue about EUR 484 m 2025 (+0.4%), GMV EUR 601 m, operating EBITDA EUR 20.1 m
repeat_signal: tyres bought every few years; seasonal change
take_rate_or_margin: operating EBITDA ~4% of revenue (computed, same source)
pl_adaptation_angle: Oponeo covers Poland; shows how thin tyre e-retail margins are

name: Caroobi
url: defunct (domain caroobi.com does not resolve, checked 2026-11-06)
physical_step: partner master workshops did the repair; Caroobi took responsibility for the job
ai_role: online booking, fixed-price expert advice, pick-up and drop-off arranged (https://www.basicthinking.de/blog/2017/08/25/autoreparaturen-caroobi 2026-11-06)
traction: USD 20 m Series B led by NGP Capital (June 2018), about USD 30 m raised in total; BMW i Ventures among investors
hype_warnings: heavy funding, then the site disappeared; forum complaints about slow repairs (https://www.autoplenum.de/forum/d/70564/caroobi-erfahrungen-bewertungen-welcher-preis 2026-11-06)
pl_adaptation_angle: graveyard: owning the repair outcome as a middleman is costly

name: Louis
physical_step: own stores (about 90) and warehouse
ai_role: no AI found
traction: about 90 stores in DE, AT, CH and NL (90th store opened in Assen, May 2023)
pl_adaptation_angle: motorcycle parts and gear by bike model; Polish market served by imports and Allegro

name: Aroundhome (wallbox)
physical_step: certified electricians install the wallbox
ai_role: online questionnaire routes the request to up to 3 firms
traction: volume not found; search snippet of its wallbox form page said firms pay per forwarded request (page 404 on 2026-11-06, unverified)
take_rate_or_margin: lead fee per contact (amount not public; unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: EV charger install leads in Poland: small but growing EV fleet; Oferteo and Fixly already sell leads

name: Fixico
physical_step: partner body shops repair; some pick-up and delivery
ai_role: photo-based damage quote; claims workflow for fleets and insurers
traction: EUR 7 m round from Autotech Ventures (2019), total EUR 14.3 m then
repeat_signal: fleet and lease clients recur (pivot to B2B, unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: photo-to-quote for body damage; in Poland insurers and leasing firms control repairs

name: Winparts
physical_step: own warehouse; ships 2,500+ parcels a day (company job page)
ai_role: search by Dutch registration (kenteken) (unverified)
traction: revenue EUR 16.25 m 2017 (Twinkle100); later acquired by AAG, part of Genuine Parts (reported by Emerce)
pl_adaptation_angle: registration-plate lookup is the friction remover; in Poland the CEPiK plate-to-model data is not openly sold (check in T10)

name: Blackcircles
physical_step: tyres delivered to a chosen partner garage for fitting
ai_role: no AI found
traction: revenue GBP 28 m 2013; 1,350 partner garages; bought by Michelin for GBP 50 m (May 2015)
pl_adaptation_angle: same pattern as Oponeo in Poland; no gap

name: BookMyGarage
physical_step: garages do the work
ai_role: price comparison and online booking of service, MOT, repair
traction: GBP 134 m of retail work booked in 2025, bookings +39%; 88% to independents
repeat_signal: yearly MOT and service drive repeat bookings (inference)
pl_adaptation_angle: annual MOT gives a yearly trigger; Polish analogue is the yearly badanie techniczne plus service

name: WhoCanFixMyCar (FixMyCar)
physical_step: garages do the work
ai_role: quote requests matched to garages
traction: acquired by Niterra (ex-NGK) in 2023, later management buyout; 15,200+ garages listed (company)
hype_warnings: ownership changed twice in a few years
pl_adaptation_angle: quote marketplace; Dobry Mechanik and Oferteo exist in Poland

name: ClickMechanic
physical_step: mobile mechanics repair at the driver's home
ai_role: instant fixed-price quotes from a pricing engine
traction: about GBP 320k angel round (2015) and USD 1 m round led by Forward Partners (2017)
pl_adaptation_angle: fixed-price quotes for common jobs; needs a mechanic network

name: Fixter
physical_step: drivers collect the car and return it; partner garages repair; 12-month warranty
ai_role: online quote and booking
traction: reported 200% revenue growth during 2020 lockdown (company press release)
hype_warnings: growth figure from lockdown period only
pl_adaptation_angle: collection-and-return for busy owners in big Polish cities; driver time is the cost

name: Tyres on the Drive
physical_step: own vans fitted tyres at home or work
ai_role: online booking
traction: Halfords minority stake up to GBP 8 m (2017); administrators called in end of January 2019
hype_warnings: failed two years after strategic investment
pl_adaptation_angle: graveyard: own fitting vans are capital- and labour-heavy

name: Oscaro
physical_step: own warehouse; ships parcels
ai_role: catalogue by registration plate
traction: revenue EUR 245.1 m 2020 (franco.wiki citing company filings, unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: owned by Parts Holding Europe; French-only

name: Mister Auto
physical_step: own warehouse; ships parcels
ai_role: catalogue by car model
traction: about EUR 100 m revenue and profitability (interview, around 2014); owned by PSA/Stellantis since 2015
hype_warnings: PSA target of EUR 300 m for 2016 not shown as met (L'argus)
pl_adaptation_angle: pan-EU parts retailer; Polish site not checked

name: Vroomly
physical_step: garages do the work
ai_role: garage price comparison; SaaS for garages; Vroomly Parts marketplace for garages (late 2020)
traction: EUR 2 m (2018) and EUR 5 m (2021) from Via ID (Mobivia)
pl_adaptation_angle: garage comparison plus parts for garages; Motointegrator covers part of this in Poland

name: iDGARAGES
physical_step: garages do the work
ai_role: online quotes and booking
traction: revenue EUR 3.5 m 2021 (+35%); about 8,000 bookings a month; 4,300 garages (2022)
pl_adaptation_angle: owned by Parts Holding Europe; small revenue despite scale: booking alone earns little

name: Allopneus
physical_step: ships tyres to ~6,000 partner fitters; 40 home-fitting franchisees
ai_role: tyre selector; company cites AI as a growth lever (interview)
traction: revenue about EUR 310 m; 300 staff; 250,000 tyres fitted at home in 2024 (press release 2 Oct 2025)
pl_adaptation_angle: Oponeo already does delivery to fitters in Poland

name: Opisto
physical_step: dismantlers (centres VHU) hold and ship parts
ai_role: software digitises used parts; 4.9 m parts listed since 2010
traction: revenue EUR 9.74 m 2024, double-digit growth (Auto-Infos)
pl_adaptation_angle: Ovoko covers this in Poland

name: Autobutler
physical_step: garages do the work; payment after the job
ai_role: up to 3 quotes from approved local garages
traction: about 2,500 garages in DK, SE, UK, FR, DE (company, undated); PSA majority owner (2016 or 2019, sources differ)
hype_warnings: Danish Competition Council found fixed-price agreements with several hundred garages (June 2023) (https://en.kfst.dk/news/decisions/2023/20230628-the-danish-competition-council-autobutler-has-infringed-competition-law 2026-11-06)
pl_adaptation_angle: quote comparison for repairs; regulatory lesson: fixed platform prices with garages can breach competition law

name: Skruvat
physical_step: own warehouse; ships parcels; sister shop Bythjul for wheels
ai_role: search by Swedish registration number (unverified)
traction: Skruvat.se and Bythjul.com revenue over SEK 1 bn and profit over SEK 30 m in 2022 (company press release); sold to Mobivia
pl_adaptation_angle: Nordic shows a local-language parts shop can beat Autodoc on home turf; Poland has Autofixer and Inter Cars doing the same

name: Autoway
physical_step: ships tyres direct to a fitting shop near the buyer; buyer pays fitting at the shop
ai_role: no AI found
traction: over 2.8 m tyres and wheels sold a year; 36 m cumulative (media article citing company)
hype_warnings: some coverage is paid PR (bestcarweb.jp tie-up articles)
pl_adaptation_angle: same pattern as Oponeo; Japan confirms delivery-to-fitter is universal

name: UP GARAGE (アップガレージ)
physical_step: buys and resells used car parts, wheels and tyres in own and franchise stores
ai_role: no AI found
traction: consolidated revenue JPY 13,981 m, operating profit JPY 1,044 m (FY to March 2025)
repeat_signal: reuse demand growing with prices (company presentation, via search summary; unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: used tuning and wheel parts in Poland trade on OLX and Allegro; graded resale with inventory is outside founder limits

name: Mycle (Macarong Factory)
physical_step: 2,000+ partner repair shops do the work
ai_role: app for car care: maintenance reminders and booking
traction: KRW 5 bn Series A from Murex Partners; 2,000+ partner shops (Jul 2024)
pl_adaptation_angle: maintenance-reminder app tied to bookings; needs a workshop network

name: Carsub
physical_step: scrapyards and suppliers ship used parts
ai_role: self-diagnosis tool; inventory software for suppliers
traction: seed funding from The Invention Lab, amount undisclosed (Apr 2025); LG Uplus corporate venture
pl_adaptation_angle: used parts for imported cars: in Poland the analogue is parts for older German cars, covered by Ovoko and OLX

name: Dr.Car (Autopedia)
physical_step: distributes imported car parts and supplies
ai_role: unknown
traction: KRW 13 bn Series A (Apr 2023)
pl_adaptation_angle: imported-car parts distribution; capital-heavy

name: Partly
physical_step: none
ai_role: AI model ('Interpreter') on licensed manufacturer data maps parts to vehicles
traction: USD 50 m Series B at USD 500 m valuation (June 2026); other sources say USD 90 m at USD 900 m
pl_adaptation_angle: shows investors pay for fit data, the core of P1; a Polish niche data play would sell to Allegro sellers

name: Oponeo
physical_step: holds tyre stock; delivers to ~1,100 partner fitting workshops in Poland
ai_role: tyre selector by car and size
traction: revenue PLN 2,370.9 m 2025, net profit PLN 58.4 m
repeat_signal: tyres bought every few years; seasonal change
pl_adaptation_angle: the incumbent for tyres; no gap

name: Inter Cars
physical_step: own warehouses; several deliveries a day to workshops
ai_role: catalogue and ordering systems for workshops (not checked)
traction: group revenue about PLN 21.2 bn 2025 (preliminary), ~9% up; Poland under 38% of group sales
pl_adaptation_angle: the main B2B supplier a Polish idea would buy from or compete with

name: Motointegrator
physical_step: parts delivered to a partner workshop that fits them
ai_role: parts search by car; workshop booking
traction: more than 1,300 cooperating workshops (Auto Świat, undated); platform in 13 countries (Inter Cars report, via search)
pl_adaptation_angle: Inter Cars' own buy-plus-fit channel: the Polish incumbent for P2 in parts

name: Autofixer
physical_step: ships parcels from warehouse (model details unverified)
ai_role: unknown
traction: about EUR 41 m revenue in first 10 months of 2026 (company); EUR 3 m venture debt from Orbit Capital (Oct 2026)

physical_step: workshops do the work
ai_role: workshop directory with reviews; paid package 'Warsztat Godny Zaufania' for workshops
traction: traction not found; workshop subscription fee in terms of service (2021)

name: carVertical
physical_step: none
ai_role: VIN history reports from 1,000+ data sources
traction: revenue EUR 53.9 m 2024 to EUR 75.8 m 2025 (+40%); Poland a key market, Polish B2B revenue +95.7%

physical_step: ships new, used and remanufactured VAG parts
ai_role: no AI found
traction: 12,208 items sold on its eBay.de store (snapshot)
